Aheesa Digital Achieves Silicon Success with Broadband Chip

Chennai-based Aheesa Digital Innovations has achieved first-pass silicon success with its broadband chip, named VIHAAN. The company, supported by the DLI scheme, plans to enter production by early 2027. This development is seen as a step towards self-reliance in semiconductor technology, potentially enhancing national security. The success marks a milestone in India's semiconductor journey, aiming to drive global manufacturing and economic growth.
